about: Design language for Calrunian places in WorkAdventure, first slice (the Dojo). Every piece the generator may place is named here; the layout code places names, never raw tile numbers. Source art: Ninja Adventure Asset Pack by Pixel-boy and AAA, CC0 (src16/LICENSE-CC0.txt), 16 px tiles drawn up 2x to WorkAdventure's 32 px.
owner_note: The map in map-storage is owned by the WorkAdventure map editor: it is edited in the client, and the editor writes the .tmj and the .wam. This language stays the contract for the art and the room rules; gen_dojo.py is a seeder, not the source of truth.

recolor.about: The one banner drawn in purple is redrawn in the water element's colours from public/ui/tokens.css (--ui-water #1a3a5c, --ui-water-glow #1a7a8a); the aesthetic contract allows no invented purples.

paving.about: 3x3 cobbled panels with one-tile seams, period 4

dojo_floor.about: 3x3 framed boards with one-tile seams, period 4

hall_thatch.about: Elder's hall, thatched; door on its south face

master_yun.about: Master Yun, standing, facing the floor

lantern_post.about: Lantern on a post, lit. Stands beside the gate path in view of the spawn: the first thing a newcomer can walk to.

rules.about: Walkable-scale rules proven on the Oddboro office round (odb-ladder-look-2): WorkAdventure v1.35 walker feet are 16x16.

first_hour.about: First-hour slice (pass wa-first-hour-1_2026-11-25). A derived sheet "lit" is drawn from the six banner tiles: a brightened banner with a gold halo, and a gold pool for the floor under it. One hidden layer per panel (lit1..lit6) holds that panel lit; dojo.js shows the layer for a player when they stand in the matching Stance area, and keeps it in their persisted state. Gold is the lantern gold of the Lantern Walk notices.
